text_block_list.text:
The one who emerged victorious from the 
fiercely contested Japanese Derby was 
Mejiro Ryan.

Amid the cheers for the new Derby 
Umamusume, applause and praise also 
erupted for Ines Fujin, who had poured her 
heart and soul into running all-out.

Ines Fujin mustered her remaining strength 
and waved enthusiastically to answer her 
fans' cheers.

And upon returning to the waiting room, 
Ines Fujin collapsed onto the floor...
